actions: **Pull the new image; nothing else changes.** No database changes and no configuration files to replace: `./update.sh v2.16.1`.
fixes: **Security: Python updated to 3.12.15 (CVE-2026-82049).** The October Python release fixes a flaw in how archives are unpacked: a crafted archive could use a hard link to a symbolic link to reach a file outside the folder being unpacked into. The platform unpacks archives in one place — restoring a backup — and already refused any archive containing a link before unpacking it, so it was not exposed; the update removes the underlying flaw as well. New tests prove both layers.
**Not affected: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) and "Node2Shell".** The platform contains no PHP and no Node.js — not in the application, its images, or its web server.
